alpha_calibration.input: noise-only circular complex Gaussian sigma2=1.0; complete frozen 33x128 Python MF->first-diff MTI->32 Doppler FFT->linear power; 7x7 CA-CFAR window, 3x3 excluded and 40 training; valid range 3..109 and Doppler 3..28
alpha_calibration.seed_algorithm: PCG64 SeedSequence([311091604, i, 191]) for i=0,...,4095; fresh independent CPI
alpha_calibration.method: For each valid CUT compute ratio R=P_CUT/(mean 40 training powers); if ANY nonfinite or mean <=0 then FAIL. Aggregate all N=4096*2782 ratios; target number alarms K=round(0.001*N); choose alpha=sorted(R)[N-K-1] using stable float64 rank. Strict alarm R>alpha; never read prospective validation outputs to set alpha. No optional stopping.
pass_conditions: ALL 4096 CPI processed and all 4096*2782 ratios finite with strictly positive training mean
actual strict alarm fraction on calibration corpus differs from 0.001 by <=0.00001 (ties yield fewer alarms; otherwise predeclared quantile gives near exact target)
independent locked source/seed/hash/time and software versions recorded
alpha_calibration.failure_action: FAIL and stop any dependent post-alpha validation, no retuning or alternate alpha without engineer approval

post_alpha_real_chain_diagnostic.seed_algorithm: PCG64 SeedSequence([311091603, i, 191]) for i=0,...,4095, independent of all alpha and CI data
count_metrics: sample lag 1 and 1..20 Ljung-Box Q at one-sided 1%
spatial_metrics: range nearest neighbor positive-positive pair rates normalized by 106*26 opportunities
Doppler nearest neighbor positive-positive pair rates normalized by 107*25 opportunities
paired CPI-level difference of pair rates and z score for equal expectation under exchangeable-CUT Beta-binomial hypothesis
post_alpha_real_chain_diagnostic.statistical_spatial_acceptance_rule: For transport from exchangeable Binomial/Beta-binomial count-surrogates to real range-Doppler map, require (A) Ljung-Box Q(20) p>=0.01 for independent CPI-count model, (B) absolute paired spatial-neighbor anisotropy z<=2.5758293035489004 (99% two-sided) under exchangeable CUT null, (C) exact observed zero and F>=8 rates with 99% Wilson CI overlap the envelope from 5 frozen models {Binomial rho0, Beta-Binomial rho .001,.01,.03,.05} at p=.001, and (D) all diagnostic inputs independent, finite, 2782 valid CUT. All requirements mandatory. Failure => real-chain sufficiency NOT ESTABLISHED; BLOCK main Pfa and refer engineer; never tune alpha or CI.
post_alpha_real_chain_diagnostic.conservatism: These are necessary diagnostics, not sufficient to prove operational 95% coverage. Even if all pass, an independent 4096-CPI count-level coverage validation at multiple known p or a proven stationary generating model may be needed before declaring readiness; engineer must review readiness before main Pfa.
post_alpha_real_chain_diagnostic.failure_action: BLOCK and stop dependent acceptance testing; preserve all failures and report engineering options

separate_cluster_diagnostic.source: noise-free deterministic 3 targets, with fixed alpha only for diagnostic not acceptance
outputs: range sidelobe offset and matched filter response

stopping_rule: one fixed calibration corpus and one fixed independent spatial diagnostic corpus; no adaptive sample count, thresholds or model choice. Do not run main Pfa even on success until user reviews gate-readiness.
